development_rehearsal.decision: Retain 2048 for the proposed final configuration based on all five v2 development responses

generation.reproducibility_scope: Recheck stored SQL outputs and replay decisions from stored observations; exact regeneration is not guaranteed

proposed_decision_policy.ties: Retain eleven pairs; equal values count in neither direction
proposed_decision_policy.aa_gate: Block if nine pairs exceed the primary reduction in either direction
proposed_decision_policy.query_recommendation: All four declared environments must pass

query_selection.disclosure: Pilot-informed method; all five families were inspected. These are new instances within seen families, not unseen schemas or workloads.

measurement_schedule.pair_order: Zero-based even pairs A_THEN_B; odd pairs B_THEN_A; actual order and pair index are required observations
measurement_schedule.interruption: Mark a started partial case INCONCLUSIVE; resume only unstarted cases; preserve all attempts

fixture_registry.coverage_statement: Agreement on finite schema-validated fixtures, not semantic proof

exactly_nine_primary_wins_including_pair.purpose: Report potential first-pair sensitivity without changing the declared schedule

capture_fields: Engine CPU/memory and container CPU/memory/swap limits
Windows power scheme, overlay mode and AC/battery state
environment_guard.integration_status: Development runner checks full environment and snapshot before/after timing cases, effective settings before each case, and power before each measured execution; transient changes between probes may not be detected

predeclared_limitations.predictable_timeout: The original NOT IN family timed out at SF1/256kB in pilot and rehearsal. Further timeouts are expected, not assumed. Retain all planned cases, the 15000 ms limit, and the all-four recommendation rule; do not extend or impute times.
predeclared_limitations.runtime_scope: Instrumented PostgreSQL execution time, not API/planning/end-to-end time

development_noise_context.definition: 100*B < 90*A or 100*A < 90*B; primary effect in either direction
development_noise_context.interpretation: Descriptive, not a statistical test; within-case pairs need not be independent

predeclared_limitations.power: Retain Balanced on AC, as in the rehearsal; hold scheme and overlay identity constant
predeclared_limitations.generalization: New instances within five already-seen families and the same schema; no unseen-family/schema or general-equivalence claim
predeclared_limitations.privacy: Host executable paths are supplied locally at execution time and excluded from this identity; no redaction of hashed fields is needed
predeclared_limitations.funnel_units: Generation and response validity per original query; subsequent gates per environment case
